question_en:
The college archives contain this old indoor photograph. Please answer the following questions:

1. Locate the building file corresponding to the photograph. Among all survey drawings in this file, which three drawings can jointly locate the room based on the glass windows visible in the photograph? Please provide the drawing numbers for these three drawings respectively.
2. Based on the drawings and the caption for the archival photograph, in which room was the photograph taken? Please provide the room number, the building section where it is located, the floor level, and its use in 1979.
3. What name was later adopted for this part of the building?

Answer format: Please answer in separate points numbered (1)–(3); answer all three questions in text, providing the three drawing numbers, the four items of information for the room, and the later used name respectively.
answer:
(1) The drawing numbers for the three drawings are 15, 18, and 26 respectively.

(2) Room number: O 207; Building section: Oglebay Hall, i.e., the north end/north wing of Old Main; Floor level: Second floor; Use in 1979: laboratory.

(3) Kirkpatrick Hall of Life Sciences.
